description: Price analyze_reference for an asset_id or a source_url and a mode before starting it: credits_estimate is what a start holds and charges once it succeeds (70 full, 10 data), 0 when the asset or the reel already has an analysis in that mode that a start would answer (replays_analysis_id), and 0 when a start would redo an analysis made before frames and speakers were added. A YouTube or unknown link is refused here too. Free; starts nothing.

asset_id.description: asset_id of an MP4 asset of this account, at most 120 s and 100 MiB

mode.description: full (default, 70 credits): the reference_profile. data (10 credits): duration, size, timed transcript, hook and a 3×3 frame sheet, without beats or graphics

source_url.description: instead of asset_id: an Instagram reel or post link (instagram.com/reel/<code>, /reels/<code>, /p/<code>) or a TikTok video link…

name: quote_analysis
title: Quote a reference analysis
